comparison.objective: Set timing-belt tension and lock an idler; candidate sets shock-absorber damping and locks its collar.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold a spring-loaded lever at a marked band while quarter-turning a pivot knob versus counterhold, loosen a recessed setscrew, finely rotate a collar, relock with bounded torque, and cycle-test.
comparison.success_condition: Pointer retained in the green band after both hands release versus two repeatable physical stops satisfying energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and witness-drift requirements.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record because both adjust and lock a mechanism bimanually. The candidate nevertheless tests a meaningfully different ability: tool-mediated fastener handling plus iterative tuning from dynamic impact response, rather than holding a static indicated tension and locking once.
